summary.tldr: Creates a medal for eligible Canadian Forces, RCMP, firefighter and first responder service in designated domestic emergency relief operations.
what_it_does: Establishes the Special Service Medal for Domestic Emergency Relief Operations and lets the Governor in Council set its design and ribbon.
Allows the medal for at least seven days of service in domestic emergency relief operations designated by the Governor in Council.
Limits the medal to one award per person, but allows extra bars for service in more than one operation.
Allows the medal to be awarded after death, and says it may be presented to the person chosen by the nominating minister.
Lets federal and provincial ministers nominate or recommend eligible Canadian Forces, RCMP, firefighter and first responder recipients.
Lets the Governor in Council make regulations about excluded classes of people and who may be nominated.
